title.en: NVIDIA names Colette Kress interim CEO after Huang resigns
title.zhHans: 黄仁勋辞任 CEO，NVIDIA 任命 Colette Kress 为临时 CEO

searchSummary.en: NVIDIA announced Jensen Huang’s resignation as CEO, effective immediately, and named Colette Kress interim CEO.
searchSummary.zhHans: NVIDIA 宣布黄仁勋辞去 CEO 职务并立即生效，由 Colette Kress 担任临时 CEO。

summary.en: Dated 2026-11-12: NVIDIA announced Jensen Huang’s resignation as CEO, effective immediately, and named Colette Kress interim CEO.
summary.zhHans: 2026-11-12，NVIDIA 宣布黄仁勋辞去 CEO 职务并立即生效，由 Colette Kress 担任临时 CEO。

narrative.en: NVIDIA states Huang resigned as president, CEO and board member effective immediately; Kress became interim CEO while remaining CFO, and Harvey C. Jones became board chair. This executive and board transition is distinct from the already published November 8 board inquiry. Neither the inquiry nor surrounding allegations establish a cause for the resignation.
narrative.zhHans: NVIDIA 称黄仁勋辞去总裁、CEO 及董事职务并立即生效；Kress 在继续担任 CFO 的同时出任临时 CEO，Harvey C. Jones 出任董事会主席。任免不同于已发布的 11 月 8 日董事会调查；不能据调查或其他未经核实的指控推断辞任原因。

text.en: NVIDIA announced Jensen Huang’s resignation as CEO, effective immediately, and named Colette Kress interim CEO.

text.en: NVIDIA said Huang also left its board and Harvey C. Jones became board chair.
